guarantees.claim: out_ack is continuously assigned the type-cast of out_ack_raw to sp2v_e.
err_o is the logical OR of en_err and out_ack_err.

assumptions.claim: The parameter SecMasking must be 1 (masking enabled).
assumptions.risk: If violated, the design may operate without side-channel masking, exposing secret key material through power/EM leakage.

assumptions.claim: SecSBoxImpl must be a masked variant (CanrightMasked, CanrightMaskedNoreuse, Dom) when SecMasking is enabled, and an unmasked variant (Lut, Canright) when SecMasking is disabled.
assumptions.risk: A mismatched configuration could cause unmasked S‑box operations inside a masked cipher core, leaking side‑channel information.

assumptions.claim: When cfg_valid_i is asserted, op_i must be one of CIPH_FWD or CIPH_INV.
assumptions.risk: An invalid cipher operation selector could lead to incorrect round‑key generation and subsequent cryptographic failure.

assumptions.claim: When cfg_valid_i is asserted, key_len_i must be AES_128, AES_192, or AES_256.
assumptions.risk: An unsupported key length value would cause the key expansion to produce a wrong key schedule, breaking encryption/decryption.
